purpose: silver_ourairports_runways cleans the bronze ourairports_runways capture into a typed runway reference table with one row per runway record identified by id, feeding downstream airport infrastructure and routing analytics.
usage: Consumers should treat id as the unique key, join on airport_ref or airport_ident to airport tables, and expect le_*/he_* geographic, elevation, heading, and displaced-threshold fields to be null for a meaningful share of rows (null rates ranging from about 0.1% up to about 90%) rather than treating nulls as errors; lighted and closed are now boolean flags.
limitations: Latitude, longitude, elevation, heading, and displaced-threshold fields for both runway ends carry substantial null rates (roughly 0.22 to 0.90), reflecting incomplete source data that this cleanup did not impute; heading fields retain fractional precision and were not cast to integer because samples include non-integral values like 1.12 and 0.1 through 0.9.
